title: El Bedel de la Uni
subtitle: Management and creation of content for a novel's networks
description:
I designed the complete visual identity of the book, ensuring aesthetic coherence between the cover, the color palette and the overall graphic style. I generated graphic pieces for social media and print designs for the launch of the novel. I also developed a web page and a book trailer to reinforce its diffusion campaign.

El Bedel de la Uni is a romance and mystery novel set in Barcelona in the 80s. Carla, a young university student in love with a professor, is involved in a chilling event that makes her life take a totally unexpected turn.
